svg.title: NODO AI layered Azure architecture
svg.desc: Public edge and identity, a mandatory API gateway, private zone-redundant compute, a mandatory AI gateway to the models, private data services, a warm standby region, and cross-cutting operations.
svg.text: Layered architecture · the public edge and the API gateway in front, the AI gateway in front of the models, every data service private, a warm standby region behind
Token check · rate limit per user
AZURE VNET · PRIVATE SUBNETS · THREE AVAILABILITY ZONES · PRIVATE ENDPOINTS · NO PUBLIC DATA ENDPOINT
02 · PRIVATE COMPUTE (CONTAINER APPS · INTERNAL · WORKER SCALES ON THE QUEUE)
· sources only if the model is down
WORKER JOBS · KEDA ON THE QUEUE
stateless · idempotent at every stage · bounded retries
audio erased by policy · every 6 h
search and graph vs database · weekly
called by the worker over a private endpoint
Only PostgreSQL and audio are irreplaceable.
The search index and the entity vectors are derived and rebuilt;
a weekly check finds drift and the reindex job repairs it.
03 · AI GATEWAY · THE ONLY PATH TO THE MODELS
chat and embeddings · EU data zone · two regions
callers: the API (questions) and the worker (extraction)
05 · STANDBY REGION · WARM DATA, COLD COMPUTE
recovery point: seconds (database) · minutes (audio) · recovery time target: 30 to 60 minutes
second accounts, retried by the gateway
one switch scales it up: dr_active
no keys · no shared storage key
basic and professional tiers · tests in CI
